title: In silico investigations and molecular insights for designing tRNA-encoded peptides as potential therapeutics for targeting over-expressed receptors in breast cancer.
one_liner_zh: 该研究用分子对接和MD模拟设计tRNA编码肽靶向乳腺癌受体，虽涉及蛋白-肽互作建模，但对象为受体-肽而非TF-DNA，方法可迁移但非本课题核心体系。
abstract: tRNA- Encoded Peptides (tREPs) have recently been discovered as new functional peptides and hold promise as therapeutics for anti-parasitic applications. In this study, in silico investigations were conducted to design tRNA-encoded peptides with the potential to target over-expressed receptors in breast cancer cells. tRNA genes were translated into corresponding peptides (tREPs) using computational tools. The tREPs, which were predicted as anticancer peptides, were then screened for various ADMET properties. Molecular docking studies were conducted for three cancer target receptors, the Estrogen Receptor (ER), Peroxisome Proliferator-Activated Receptor (PPAR) and the Epidermal Growth Factor Receptor (EGFR). Based on the docking results, specific tREPs were screened and molecular dynamics simulations were performed, and the binding energies were further explored using MMPBSA calculations. The peptide Pep1 (DWIAWRHHNDIVSWLTCGPRFKSWS) and Pep2 (GFIAWWSRHLELAQTRFKSWWS) exhibited a good binding affinity against the Estrogen Receptor (ER) and the Peroxisome Proliferator-Activated Receptor Alpha (PPAR) cancer target. The Pep1-ER and Pep1-PPAR complex maintained an average of two hydrogen bonds throughout the simulation and demonstrated a higher negative binding free energy of -72.27 kcal/mol and -65.16 kcal/mol respectively, as calculated by MMPBSA. Therefore, the tREPs designed as anticancer peptides in this study provide novel approaches for potential anticancer therapeutic modalities.
abstract_zh: tRNA编码肽（tREPs）最近被发现为新型功能肽，并在抗寄生虫应用中展现出作为治疗药物的前景。在本研究中，进行了计算机模拟研究，以设计能够靶向乳腺癌细胞中过表达受体的tRNA编码肽。利用计算工具将tRNA基因翻译成相应的肽（tREPs）。预测为抗癌肽的tREPs随后筛选了各种ADMET性质。针对三种癌症靶标受体，即雌激素受体（ER）、过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体（PPAR）和表皮生长因子受体（EGFR），进行了分子对接研究。基于对接结果，筛选出特定的tREPs，并进行了分子动力学模拟，同时通过MMPBSA计算进一步探索了结合能。肽Pep1（DWIAWRHHNDIVSWLTCGPRFKSWS）和Pep2（GFIAWWSRHLELAQTRFKSWWS）对雌激素受体（ER）和过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体α（PPAR）癌症靶标表现出良好的结合亲和力。Pep1-ER和Pep1-PPAR复合物在整个模拟过程中平均维持两个氢键，并通过MMPBSA计算显示出更高的负结合自由能，分别为-72.27 kcal/mol和-65.16 kcal/mol。因此，本研究中设计的作为抗癌肽的tREPs为潜在抗癌治疗模式提供了新方法。
